# kion_service_control_policy (Resource)

Manages a Kion Service Control Policy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_service_control_policy" "example" {
  # Required
  name   = "example"
  policy = "example"

  # Optional
  # description          = "example"
  # owner_user_group_ids = []
  # owner_user_ids       = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the Service Control policy in the application.
- `policy` (String) Text of the Service Control policy in AWS to be stored in AWS.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description for the Service Control policy in the application.
- `owner_user_group_ids` (Set of Number) List of groups IDs who will own the service_control policy. Is required if no owner user IDs are listed.
- `owner_user_ids` (Set of Number) List of user IDs who will own the service_control policy. Is required if no owner group IDs are listed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service Control policy ID.
